title: Dan says his patch makes injection impossible
brief: Dan has opened a pull request against the order lookup. His description reads: "Escaped the quotes, so injection is now impossible. Quick one to merge." It is your review.

reasons.text: Doubling quotes is not enough escaping; backslashes also need handling.
The id sits in the query with no quotes around it, so an attack never needs a quote.
req.session.userId is spliced in too, and that is the real risk.
Running replace() on every request will slow the endpoint down.

reasonExplanations.backslash: true in some databases, but not the problem here: this attack needs no quote to escape in the first place
reasonExplanations.userid: userId comes from the server's own session, not from the request, so the attacker cannot choose it
reasonExplanations.performance: a replace() on a short string costs microseconds; the patch is unsafe, not slow
reasonExplanations.numeric: this patch is not correct -- 1 OR 1=1 contains no quote at all

functionalSuite.label: A customer viewing their own order

hints: Look at where the id lands in the SQL. Is it inside quotes?
Escaping quotes only helps if the attacker needs a quote. Try writing an attack without one.
